blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. What is the smallest whole number that solves two x minus one is greater than seven?
Add one to both sides, by the addition property. Two x is greater than eight.
Divide both sides by two, by the division property. X is greater than four. Four itself is not included, so the smallest whole number is five.
Watch out for these traps. If you include the boundary, you get four. If you give the boundary the wrong sign, you get negative three.
